title: Vacuum Stability
description: What could stop a universe from starting at all? A vacuum energy a little larger and it would fly apart before stars formed; a Higgs coupling a little smaller and the vacuum would be unstable. Ours sits, by measurement, at the edge: metastable. Unlocks the Metastable Vacuum Lattice.

puzzle.goal: The quartic coupling λ of the Higgs field is not a constant: it runs with the energy scale μ. The top quark, with Yukawa coupling y, dominates the running and drives λ down logarithmically from its value λ₀ at the top mass m. Write λ at scale μ in this top-dominated approximation.
puzzle.name: Top-loop running of the scalar quartic coupling (renormalisation group)
puzzle.ask: The vacuum becomes unstable where λ(μ) = 0, at μ = m·exp(8π²λ₀/(3y⁴)). With λ₀ = λ, y and m (GeV) given, find that scale in TeV (with every other loop included it moves to about 10¹⁰ GeV - our vacuum is metastable).

vars.\u03bb: Higgs quartic coupling (at the top mass)

puzzle.method: The top loop gives dλ/d ln μ = −3y⁴/(8π²). Hold y fixed and integrate from ln m to ln μ.
